rationale.edition: Both changed files live under tests/ui-testing/ (pages/logsPages/ and playwright-tests/Logs/), which is OSS test infrastructure. No enterprise/cloud-owned paths, no web/src feature-gate (isCloud/isEnterprise/withFeatureGate), and no #[cfg(feature=...)] backend code, so the change is oss.
rationale.skip: Not skipped. The change is test-only (a new page-object helper plus a new Playwright test), but it modifies a Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/, which the rules treat as NOT an auto-skip — set existing_tests_in_diff=true and continue so the Architect can review/enhance. No explicit opt-out label or skip comment was supplied.
rationale.e2e: E2E is warranted: the diff adds a test that verifies the logs toolbar 'syntax guide' pin's state through its menu pin-button title, a user-facing UI flow (logs toolbar pinning). The spec and page object already exist and this diff extends that coverage rather than introducing a brand-new flow.
rationale.area: Logs — the changed spec sits under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/Logs/ and its page object under pages/logsPages/; sibling logs specs (join, logspage, shareLink, etc.) live in the same Logs area.
rationale.group: Logs-Core is the closest existing matrix shard for core logs toolbar interactions (actual_folder: Logs). The spec's @logs/@toolbarPins tags map to the Logs area and toolbar pinning is a core logs UI interaction rather than a query/index feature, so Logs-Core fits.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff modifies logsToolbarPins.spec.js (a real Playwright E2E spec under tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/) and its page object, adding a new test for the syntax-guide pin state — that IS E2E coverage of the new assertion. No Vitest or Rust unit tests are involved.
